name: How often should sliding door flashing be inspected or maintained?

mainEntity.name: How often should sliding door flashing be inspected or maintained?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's advisable to visually inspect your sliding door flashing annually, especially after heavy rains or significant weather events. Look for any visible signs of wear, cracks, or gaps. While the flashing itself doesn't typically require routine maintenance beyond ensuring surrounding caulk is intact, proactive checks can help catch minor issues before they escalate into major water damage. Address any concerns promptly to maintain protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Inspect sliding door flashing annually, especially after heavy rains, checking for wear, cracks, or gaps to prevent extensive water damage.
